utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the twenty-eighth. Usual quick run-through, once Teams decides we're all allowed to hear each other.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, I'm here. Had the wrong headset selected.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: You're coming through twice, mate.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: There. Laptop speakers. Better?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, fine. More importantly, there's a birthday cake in the office. Quite a serious amount of icing.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: That's breakfast sorted, then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Excellent nutritional advice from stores.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Would go nicely with a coffee, if the coffee machine in the canteen wasn't broken.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Still? It's basically an ornament now.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah. Just a moan, not offering to fix it.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And the traffic on the ring road was ridiculous. Sat there staring at the same van for ages.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: I came round the other way. Not much better.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Proper Monday, then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before we disappear into the travel report, anything finished that we can get out of the way?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, already swapped the filter on the line 1 TCU yesterday. That's done, not another one for today.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Ah, that's the TCU one. I nearly mixed those two up.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Exactly. line 1 TCU, finished yesterday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And separately, already swapped the filter on the line one HPU yesterday. That one's closed as well.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Right, two different filters, both done.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep. Neither needs carrying forward.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Just an observation from nights: noticed the number two bearing was running a bit warm, but it settled down.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Settled back rather than staying warm?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, settled back. Nothing I'm raising as a job off that.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Similar sort of thing from me. Heard a slight rattle from the Injection Moulding Line 2, nothing to action yet.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Not a constant racket, then?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: No, just slight. Observation only.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. There is still a need to investigate the pressure drop on the water booster this morning. Low priority, to be clear. Anyone actually able to take that?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I can't get to the water booster until production gives us a window.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: So access is the blocker, rather than us having someone lined up?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah. I'm not taking it on with no access window.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: There isn't a confirmed window to work against.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. Nobody taking the water booster, then. This morning is still the requested timing, low priority, but it's unowned and blocked.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Understood. Not quietly landed against someone's name.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Um, I'll run a function test on the Compressed Air Dryer by the end of the week.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers, Jamie. That's very much an 'if you've got a spare minute' one, not something to push other work out for.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, spare-minute job. I'll fit the function test in by the end of the week.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Just the function test, yeah? Not a strip-down dressed up as a quick look?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Just the function test on the Compressed Air Dryer. No mystery extras.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Famous last words in this place.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No mystery extras in the agreement, anyway. Jamie's got that.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: I'll schedule downtime for the Cooling Tower with production next week.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Fi. Whenever you get a chance next week; no need to force it up the queue.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep, I'll do the scheduling with production next week, whenever I get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: That's agreeing the downtime, not saying we've already got a shutdown slot?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Exactly. No slot agreed yet. It's the scheduling I'm taking.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good, Fi, that's clear.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Right, I'll clear the jam and check the sensors on the Palletiser.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Sorry, talked over the end there. Sensors as well as clearing it?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, both. I'll clear the jam and check the sensors. Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Priya Raman taking the Palletiser, normal priority.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Always tempting to call it fixed as soon as the stuck pallet moves.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Mm, hence the sensor check being part of it, not an afterthought.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: And I'll send the shift handover report round by Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Aisha Begum. By Wednesday for the report going round.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yep, that's mine.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Sorry, tiny bit of audio dropout. Was that Wednesday?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: By Wednesday, yeah. The shift handover report.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. That's the lot. The finished filters stay finished, and the observations aren't new jobs.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Nor the coffee machine. Especially the coffee machine.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Your objection is on the record. Cheers, everyone.
